How a project opens

From proposal to a live door.

01

Verified first

Beneficiary, authorised account, scope and approvals are confirmed in writing before anything is announced.

02

Opened on the foundation

The project inherits the design, contact routing, reporting rhythm and trust already built — days of work, not months.

03

Reported until finished

Reconciled figures and progress updates run on the updates feed until the work is complete — and stay on the record after.
